enchantments.tooltip: +5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Poisonous 3: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to drip with a vile venom, dealing 3d6 poison damage on each hit.
Toxic 7: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to drip with a vile venom, dealing 7d6 poison damage on each critical hit.

Nightshade Venom 45: Any creature struck by this weapon must succeed on a Difficulty Check 45 Fortitude save or fall unconscious. The target may attempt a new save to end the effect every several seconds; otherwise the sleep lasts for 20 seconds.
Vampirism 1: This weapon thirsts for the blood of your enemies, healing you for +1d2 hit points with each hit.Note: internal cooldown of 1 second.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
